set.body:
Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md §3 Phase 1b Published comparator.

The published Sherlock method (doi 10.1038/s41562-021-01051-6). Its 30-event segmentation is recorded as TopicHmmEvent30 and marked recall-tuned (docs/data/sherlock/README.md:59; audit:67).

Scope:
Run or reuse the method's outputs and score them on the same units.

Acceptance criteria:
1. The method is re-run or its released outputs are used; source and version or commit are recorded.
2. The 30 events are mapped to the 50-scene task by a rule declared before scoring; the recall-tuning asymmetry is stated in the leaderboard.
3. Scored by the repaired scorer on the same units, with receipts.
4. A dated study-log ledger entry (docs/plans/2026-09-02-recall-to-video-study-log.md) naming this read, its estimand and its participants is committed before the first gold read; the readout verifies the commit order.

Gate: every script in tools/recall-study/tests exits 0 (`for t in tools/recall-study/tests/test_*.py;
do python3 "$t" || exit 1; done`), new tests included; a named mutation witness per new guard; no
recall prose or participant text committed (hashes and aggregates only); fresh-context cold review;
the commit body states the evidence and what it does not establish.

Size: M.
set.title: Phase 1b: published comparator -- Heusser, Fitzpatrick & Manning (2021) on Sherlock
